TC-19/S27.detail: B03 re-check on 8b4be94a: FIXED. (c) 'Hold metformin, poor intake.' -> reload when the note is stored -> metformin Held, reason 'Hold metformin, poor intake.'; (d-reload) 'Hold the apixaban, procedure tomorrow.' -> reload -> apixaban Held (both runs). The medication extraction now runs on the server after the note (convex/lib/noteFollowUps.ts), so a reload or a closed app no longer loses it. Both holds are dated 'Oct 19', the server's UTC day, while the physician's day is Oct 20 (accepted by the original check; candidate rb2-C1). Local cells (a) and (b) pass.
